title: Engineering mode option to disable encryption for exporting settings is missing?
body:
**AndroidAPS 2.8.2.8-dev**
Build: 8fe7e7ce2
Flavor: fulldebug

**Problem description:**
Engineering mode option to disable encryption for exporting settings file seems to be missing?
Settings only shows "Email recipient" and "No of logs to send".

Is this a bug or intentional or did the option maybe move?

comments.body: unencrypted backups are not supported anymore
